channel.title: Lynn Group Media - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Lynn Group Media (hoganstand.com)

item.title: Br Bosco Cup quarter-final draw made
item.description: The draw for the Br Bosco Cup (Leinster Post Primary Schools Senior Football 'A' Championship) quarter-finals has taken place.

item.title: Tipperary All-Ireland documentary on the way
item.description: Tipperary GAA is releasing a behind-the-scenes documentary this Christmas charting the county's journey to All-Ireland hurling glory.

item.title: 2026 Cork GAA Championship draws take place
item.description: The draws have been made for the 2026 Cork GAA adult championships.

item.title: Murray is new Padraig Pearses manager
item.description: Roscommon giants Padraig Pearses have installed Niall Murray as their new senior football manager.

item.title: Roe vacates Portarlington hotseat
item.description: Pat Roe has stepped down after two successful seasons in charge of Portarlington.

item.title: Brislane takes Turloughmore reins
item.description: Eoin Brislane has been appointed as the new Turloughmore senior hurling manager.

item.title: Murray appointed St Finbarr's hurling boss
item.description: Former Cork camogie boss Paudie Murray has been named as the new St Finbarr's senior hurling manager.

item.title: Higgins succeeds McMahon in Naas
item.description: Naas have turned to Cavan man Jimmy Higgins in their quest to regain the Kildare SFC title in 2026.

item.title: Camogie Association announce Karen Dessain-Gelinet as new Ard Stiúrthóir
item.description: The Camogie Association has announced Karen Dessain-Gelinet as their new CEO.

item.title: Clifford coaches alma mater to Munster U17 success
item.description: St Brendan's College, Killarney retained the Frewen Cup (Munster Post Primary Schools U17 'A' Championship) yesterday with David Clifford fronting their management team.
